english.title: Premises licence holder / nominated person fail to produce licence / copy - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the holder of the premises licence for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), and having]_
(B)_[a person who works at licensed premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), nominated by the holder of the premises licence to have]_

custody or control of the premises licence or a certified copy of it failed without reasonable excuse to produce the licence or copy when required to

(C)_[a constable]_
(D)_[an authorised person]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 57(7) and (8) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the holder of the premises licence OR
a person who works at licensed premises
nominated by the holder of the premises licence to have
custody/control of the premises licence/certified copy
failed without reasonable excuse
to produce licence/copy when required
to a constable/authorised person

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
